rome-central-italy-tuscany-val-d-orcia-o.slogan: A 608 km loop out of Tuscany Val d’Orcia Overnight
rome-central-italy-tuscany-val-d-orcia-o.story: A proper escape from Rome with roads worth waking up for. A 608 km loop that starts and ends near Anzio, about 11 h 04 of riding. It goes by way of Civitavecchia, near Canino and Castelvecchio Calvisio. Marina di Ardea-Tor San Lorenzo is the high point. It tops out at about 1,200 m. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.

scenicChapters.title: Fiavé-Lago Carera → Dolomiti di Brenta
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 27 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.
